name: wlog
description: Build a workout program from the WLog exercise library and open it in the WLog app with one link.

interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT the training you want and WLog turns it into a program you can start on your phone.

Describe your goal, how many days you train and the equipment you have. ChatGPT picks every exercise from the WLog exercise library of 1,000+ movements, so each one comes with a demo, written steps and a muscle map in the app. WLog saves the program and gives you a link: open it on your phone and the program is ready to train in WLog, with sets and rep targets filled in.

Works for full-body plans, upper/lower and push/pull/legs splits, dumbbell-only and bodyweight training, or a program you paste in yourself. Program and workout names follow your language.

No WLog account or sign-in is needed, and nothing is read from your training history.
defaultPrompt: Build me a 3-day full-body beginner program with dumbbells.
Make a 4-day upper/lower strength split in WLog.
Turn my workout plan into a WLog routine.

positive.description: Beginner full-body program with limited equipment
positive.prompt: Build me a 3-day full-body workout program for a beginner who only has dumbbells, and give me the WLog link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_exercises (with the dumbbell equipment filter or dumbbell queries) to get real exercise ids, then calls create_routine with 3 workouts of dumbbell exercises, and shows the returned https://wlogapp.com/r/ link with a short summary of each workout.

positive.description: Strength split built around named lifts
positive.prompt: Make a 4-day upper/lower strength program built around squat, bench press, deadlift and overhead press, 3-6 reps on the main lifts. Save it to WLog.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for each named lift and accessories, then calls create_routine with 4 workouts (2 upper, 2 lower) using the returned ids and rep targets such as "3-5" or "5" on the main lifts, and returns the program link.

positive.description: Converting a program the user pastes
positive.prompt: Turn this into a WLog routine. Day A: back squat 5x5, bench press 5x5, barbell row 5x5. Day B: back squat 5x5, overhead press 5x5, deadlift 1x5.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up each exercise with search_exercises, then calls create_routine with two workouts named Day A and Day B, keeping the given sets and reps (5 sets of "5", deadlift 1 set of "5"), and returns the link.

positive.prompt: Which exercises in WLog train the hamstrings with just bodyweight?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_exercises with muscle hamstrings and equipment bodyweight and lists the matching exercise names. Does not call create_routine because the user did not ask for a program.

positive.description: Program named in the user's language
positive.prompt: Bana haftada 3 gün push/pull/legs programı hazırla ve WLog linkini ver.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches exercises in English, then calls create_routine with Turkish program and workout names (for example "İtme", "Çekme", "Bacak") and locale tr_TR, and replies in Turkish with the WLog link.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Personal training history is not available
negative.prompt: Show me the workouts I logged in WLog last week.

negative.description: Nutrition planning is out of scope
negative.prompt: Write me a 7-day meal plan with calories for each meal.

publication.release_notes: First release: search the WLog exercise library and create a workout program link that opens in the WLog app.
